core: MHC class II peptide antigen presentation
qualifier: exogenous antigen processing plus its regulation
name: Exogenous antigen MHC class II presentation and its regulation
rationale: All members concern MHC class II peptide antigen processing/presentation; unlike the regulation-only confusable it includes exogenous antigen processing (including germinal center B cells), unlike C2 it includes the positive and negative regulation terms, and unlike C4 it is class II rather than class I cross-presentation.

core: Regulation of MHC class II peptide presentation
qualifier: peptide loading onto MHC class II
name: Regulation of MHC class II peptide loading and presentation
rationale: All members concern positive/negative regulation of MHC class II peptide antigen presentation and peptide-MHC II assembly, without the exogenous antigen processing and germinal center B cell members of its superset confusable or the monocyte, lipid antigen and TLR7/8 members of C3/C4.
